description: Audit of a workspace with one planted defect per major signal. The scan gate is the committed golden; the rubric checks ladder classification.
expectedBehavior: Runs the bundled scanner (scripts/scan.mjs) on the workspace before classifying, instead of eyeballing files
src/hero-animation.tsx: identifies setState per frame; recommends useTween (single value into render) or useLoop with ref-based DOM writes
src/ticker.ts: recommends useLoop for the loop and removing the per-frame getBoundingClientRect (useSize or precomputed geometry)
src/lazy-image.tsx: recommends useSight or WhenVisible over the raw IntersectionObserver
src/theme-watcher.ts: recommends one shared useMutation (visibility: 'ignore') for the documentElement class watcher
src/card.tsx: recommends naming the transitioned properties (transition-colors or similar) instead of transition-all
src/use-latest.ts: classifies the manual synced ref as correct code with an optional useSyncedRef shorthand, not a defect
src/phases/progress-meter.ts: recommends useLoop; does NOT claim the setAttribute/setProperty writes are setState-in-rAF
src/suppressed-banner.ts: treats the one-shot rAF and nearby layout read as incidental, while reporting the reason-less forced-reflow directive without silently fixing it
styles/globals.css: scopes or replaces the body:has rule, restricts the transition to transform/opacity, toggles will-change with animation state, and adds reduced-motion handling for the keyframes
Every recommendation that keeps an animation addresses prefers-reduced-motion
Findings are presented grouped by impact with a closing summary (audit.md output format)
